description.value:
At 4th level, the astrologian's understanding of fortunetelling has grown considerably, allowing her to augment her tarot cards further. After she uses the Draw ability, she may use a free action to convert that card into an empowerment for a future reading up to 1 minute from the conversion. This empowerment affects the next card that the astrologian uses to empower an ally, from either the Draw ability or Spread ability.

If the Balance or the Bole card is drawn, the effects are doubled.
If the Arrow or the Shield card is drawn, the duration is doubled.
If the Ewer or the Spire card is drawn, all allies within a 20-ft.-radius of the astrologian receive the effects.
